class.name: SceneNodePool
class.brief_description: Reusable native PackedScene nodes with bounded idle residency and per-frame maintenance.
class.description: Stores detached idle scene instances and weak ObjectID references to active leases. Instances may define on_pool_created(), on_pool_acquired(pool), and on_pool_released() callbacks. This pool is intended for presentation objects such as one-shot particles; game-authoritative state must not be recycled without an explicit gameplay reset. Use [method maintain_residency] from a client frame loop to grow or shrink the idle cache in small steps, instead of instantiating many scenes during one ready callback. Optional soft main-thread CPU-time slicing complements the count cap. Only detached idle instances are retired, never active leases. This behavior is inspired by actor reuse and incremental work budgeting in larger game engines.

method.name: prewarm
method.description: Creates detached idle nodes up to the smaller of count and [member max_idle]. This is synchronous, so prefer [method maintain_residency] for large pools.

method.name: maintain_residency
method.description: Incrementally grows or shrinks total residency, including live active leases. Returns positive created count, negative detached idle disposals, or zero. Target must be 0–4096, max_changes 1–64, and the optional soft CPU-time budget max_work_usec 0–1000000 microseconds; invalid values perform no work. With max_work_usec 0, behavior is the legacy count-only policy. Positive limits are checked between scene operations: one indivisible instance creation or deletion is always allowed, so a single operation may exceed the soft limit. Active checked-out nodes are never evicted. [method get_last_maintenance_work_usec], [method get_last_maintenance_change_count] and [method get_last_maintenance_pending_count] expose maintenance diagnostics.

method.name: should_stop_maintenance
method.description: Pure helper for testing the soft time budget. Returns false for the first operation or a zero budget, and true after at least one completed operation and the deadline has been reached.

method.name: get_last_maintenance_work_usec
method.description: Measured main-thread microseconds spent in the latest valid maintenance call, including weak-reference pruning. Zero after an invalid request. This is not GPU time.

method.name: get_last_maintenance_change_count
method.description: Signed number of instances created or disposed by the last maintain call.

method.name: get_last_maintenance_pending_count
method.description: Number of eligible additional idle scene creations or disposals required to reach the target after the most recent maintenance call. Checked-out instances cannot be retired, and never count as pending deletions.

method.name: acquire
method.description: Checks out a cached or new instance, attaches it to parent and invokes on_pool_acquired() if present; returns null on invalid parent or active cap.

method.name: release
method.description: Returns an active instance to detached idle cache or frees it if the cache is full. Rejects foreign or double returns.

method.name: release_deferred
method.description: Schedules return for a later safe scene-tree callback, useful during physics notifications.

method.name: clear_idle
method.description: Immediately frees all detached idle nodes, preserving active leases.

method.name: get_active_count
method.description: Current active lease count after pruning invalid references.

method.name: get_idle_count
method.description: Current detached cached instance count after pruning invalid references.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Lifetime counters and current residency, including maintenance_work_usec, maintenance_changes and maintenance_pending.

member.name: template
member.description: Scene template for new instances. Cannot change while instances are checked out.

member.name: prewarm_count
member.description: Target cached objects to create immediately on ready, when enabled.

member.name: prewarm_on_ready
member.description: Whether to run synchronous prewarm on ready. Disable for frame-sliced maintenance.

signal.name: capacity_exhausted
signal.description: Emitted when acquire() is rejected by the active limit.

signal.name: instance_acquired
signal.description: Emitted when an instance is acquired.

signal.name: instance_released
signal.description: Emitted after a lease is released.
